runtime/statistics#

The native layer under statistics: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under statistics: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable bulk boundary for numerically sensitive statistical algorithms. Every backend must implement the same finite-float semantics.
